name: shadowed-source
description: Issue #95: a build rule (HuxerUI's hcg) transforms src/app.cppm into target/.build-mcpp/out/hcg/src_app.cppm, which mcpp's build database describes as the unit of module app; [build] sources = [] lists no source, so src/app.cppm is in no set, and ide.generated names it as the step's input. Opened in the editor, the authored file is a shadowed source: not a second provider of app (no ambiguous-module), the root stays ready, the file says which unit stands for it, and Format Document formats it -- clangd formats its text under a scratch name beside it, and nothing clangd says of that name reaches the editor.
